company.name: Deere & Company
company.fiscalCalendar: Deere uses a 52/53-week fiscal year ending the last Sunday of October; fiscal second quarter 2026 ended 2026-05-03 and the requested forecast period FY2026Q3 is the following fiscal quarter.

sources.title: Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Call Presentation (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1)

businessModel.claim: Deere is a diversified equipment manufacturer that designs, builds and finances agriculture, turf, construction and forestry machinery, and management frames its performance around the strength of that diversified portfolio.

productsAndCustomers.claim: Deere sells production and precision agriculture equipment, small agriculture and turf equipment, and construction and forestry equipment to farmers, dealers and construction customers, supported by advanced precision technologies such as See & Spray and Harvest Settings Automation.

segmentsAndGeographies.claim: The release reports four segments — Production & Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture & Turf, Construction & Forestry, and Financial Services — with industry outlooks broken out by geography across U.S. & Canada, Europe, South America and Asia.

fiscalCalendar.claim: The fiscal second quarter of 2026 ended May 3, 2026 (versus April 27, 2025 for the prior-year quarter), and the requested forecast period is the following fiscal quarter, FY2026Q3.

revenueAndCostDrivers.claim: Segment sales and operating profit are driven by shipment volumes, price realization, foreign currency translation and production costs, with the Q2 result reflecting lower Production & Precision Ag volumes offset by strong Small Ag & Turf and Construction & Forestry performance.

accountingDefinitions.claim: The release defines segment operating profit as income before corporate expenses, certain external interest expense, certain foreign exchange gains and losses, and income taxes, and reports fully diluted GAAP EPS on the consolidated income statement.

guidanceStyle.claim: Deere guides to a full-year net income range ($4.5 billion to $5.0 billion for fiscal 2026) and provides full-year segment net-sales and Financial Services net-income outlooks rather than explicit next-quarter revenue, EPS or segment operating-profit guidance.

cyclicalityAndSeasonality.claim: Results are tied to the agricultural business cycle, which management describes as unpredictable and affected by farm income, commodity prices, crop yields, input costs and government farm programs.

externalExposures.claim: The filing identifies tariffs and the global trade environment, macroeconomic conditions, interest-rate and currency volatility, supply-chain disruption and geopolitical instability as external risks, and notes a $272 million recovery tied to the Supreme Court's invalidation of IEEPA tariffs.

signalMap.signal: Most recent quarterly worldwide net sales and revenues (proxy anchor)
signalMap.hypothesis: Deere guides full-year net income, not quarterly revenue, so the most recent reported quarterly worldwide net sales and revenues (fiscal Q2 2026, $13.369 billion) is used as the anchor starting range. Because fiscal Q2 is Deere's seasonal peak and fiscal Q3 is materially lower, a seasonal step-down driver adjusts this anchor to a Q3-aligned range.
evidenceRequired: latest filed earnings release with reported quarterly net sales and revenues
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: latest available reported quarterly figure before cutoff

Because fiscal Q2 is Deere's seasonal peak and fiscal Q3 is materially lower, a seasonal step-down driver adjusts this anchor to a Q3-aligned range.
evidenceRequired: latest filed earnings release with reported fully diluted EPS
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: latest available reported quarterly figure before cutoff

signalMap.signal: Most recent quarterly Production & Precision Ag operating profit (proxy anchor)
signalMap.hypothesis: Deere gives full-year segment net-sales outlooks but not quarterly segment operating profit, so the most recent reported Production & Precision Ag operating profit (fiscal Q2 2026, $706 million) is used as the anchor starting range. Because fiscal Q2 is the seasonal peak and fiscal Q3 is materially lower, a seasonal step-down driver guided by the segment's full-year margin outlook adjusts this anchor to a Q3-aligned range.
evidenceRequired: latest filed earnings release with reported segment operating profit
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: latest available reported quarterly figure before cutoff

signalMap.signal: Fiscal-Q3 seasonal step-down in worldwide net sales and revenues (prior-year-Q3 seasonal proxy)
signalMap.hypothesis: Deere's fiscal Q2 (ending late April/early May) is its seasonal peak and fiscal Q3 (ending late July) is materially lower; the most recent quarterly net-sales anchor is the Q2 FY2026 peak ($13.369 billion), so a seasonal additive adjustment of -1,369 USDm steps it down to a Q3-aligned range (~$12.0 billion). The magnitude is a prior-year-Q3 seasonal proxy: in the last valid-URL Q3 earnings release in the corpus (Q3 FY2019) worldwide net sales and revenues fell to $10.036 billion for the third quarter, below the preceding fiscal-Q2 peak, evidencing the recurring Q2-to-Q3 sequential decline.
evidenceRequired: quoted quarterly net-sales figure evidencing the fiscal-Q3 seasonal step-down
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: seasonal pattern from a valid-URL Q3 earnings release

signalMap.signal: Fiscal-Q3 seasonal step-down in fully diluted GAAP EPS (prior-year-Q3 seasonal proxy)
signalMap.hypothesis: Deere's fiscal Q3 EPS runs materially below the fiscal-Q2 seasonal peak; the most recent quarterly EPS anchor is the Q2 FY2026 peak ($6.55), so a seasonal additive adjustment of -2.00 USD/share steps it down to a Q3-aligned ~$4.55. The magnitude is a prior-year-Q3 seasonal proxy: in the last valid-URL Q3 earnings release in the corpus (Q3 FY2019) Deere reported $2.81 per share for the third quarter, well below the preceding fiscal-Q2 result, evidencing the recurring Q2-to-Q3 sequential EPS decline.
evidenceRequired: quoted quarterly EPS figure evidencing the fiscal-Q3 seasonal step-down
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: seasonal pattern from a valid-URL Q3 earnings release

signalMap.signal: Fiscal-Q3 seasonal step-down in Production & Precision Ag operating profit (full-year-margin-guided proxy)
signalMap.hypothesis: Production & Precision Ag operating profit peaks in fiscal Q2 and runs lower in fiscal Q3; the most recent quarterly anchor is the Q2 FY2026 peak ($706 million at a 15.7% operating margin), so a seasonal additive adjustment of -181 USDm steps it down to a Q3-aligned ~$525 million. The magnitude is guided by the segment's own full-year outlook in the Q2 FY2026 release, which forecasts a FY2026 operating margin of 11-13% on net sales down 5-10% — below the 15.7% Q2 peak margin — implying materially lower operating profit in the seasonally weaker back half.
evidenceRequired: quoted segment margin outlook evidencing lower back-half PPA operating profit
signalMap.freshnessRequirement: full-year segment outlook from the latest earnings release
